entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CS0012 emitted for internal types #80921
  • API reference is still 4.13 #80917
  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Features 5.0.0-2.final missing from NuGet.org #80915
  • Autocompletion of method overrides places method above attribute #80913

Closed

  • Unexpected error for a user-defined conditional logical operator resolution on an interface #78617
    Backlog
  • Behavior of a user-defined conditional logical operator depends on order of `true`/`false` operator declarations #78602
    18.2
  • Consider creating VerifyModifiers(MethodSymbol, DeclarationModifiers) test helper to use in DefaultInterfaceImplementationTests.cs #19116
    Backlog
  • Unexpected metadata for function signature when defined as member vs local #76847
    18.4
  • Generate VisualStudio2019.pkgdef from color xml during build #45857
  • CS9314 and CS9298 should not be created when compiling a .cs file containing #: or #! lines #80906
  • FileBasedProgram: #: directives should be respected for specifying references #80905
  • 'Go to definition' navigates to completely wrong type #80848
  • Confusing error message when using `in this` with an enum #73746
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Rename `AllowedRequiredModifierType.System_Runtime_CompilerServices_OutAttribute` to reflect actual type namespace. #80924
    Area-Compilers
  • [release/dev18.0] Fix XAML peek in VS editor. XamlPeekableItemFactory needs to implement exported interface. #80923
  • [release/dev18.0] Fix issue when caching CompilationWithAnalyzers against ProjectState instead of a project #80922
  • Avoid deep recursion for nested bound patterns #80920
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Pattern Matching
  • Clarify BoundBinaryPattern.Disjunction #80918
    Area-Compilers
  • Unify warnAsError build option between Unix and Windows #80916
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix issue with when a CR/LF split occurs at a SubText's underlying span start #80911
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Use standard lookup and overload resolution for `true`/`false` operators while binding applications of user-defined `&&`/`||` operators #80836
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Fix XAML peek in VS editor. XamlPeekableItemFactory needs to implement exported interface. #80919
    Area-IDE, Community, Next
  • Ensure that `modreq(InAttribute)` is emitted for synthesized `ref readonly` returning methods #80893
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Expand #error version output to include compiler assembly path and use full commit SHA everywhere #80894
    Next
  • Remove warning from 'in enum' extension methods #80708
    Area-Compilers, Community, Feature - Extension Everything, Next

Updated

  • Implement canonical miscellaneous files project loader for non-file-based programs #80748
    VSCode
  • Enable runtime async tests #80362
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Fix ILVerify failure: yield break in catch blocks within async iterators #80719
  • Fix parsing of delegate declarations with tuple return types at top-level #80889
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix VariablesDeclaredWalker with recursive patterns #80910
    Area-Compilers
  • Unskip tests of MSBuildWorkspace with blazor and blazorwasm templates #80468
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fbp live directive diagnostics #80575
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix csc/vbc misinterpretation of source files in root directory on Unix #80866
  • Let tuple/anonymous member name inference see through null suppression operator #80908
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Improve compiler error recovery for null coalesce assignment operator #80907
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Consider PATH again when searching for dotnet host #80859
    Area-Compilers
  • Add snap script #80591
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix ref safety holes in delegate conversions across old/new rule boundaries #80876
